create_rpc_host: create a moolib Rpc host that listens on 127.0.0.1:1234 and defines callable functions
connect_rpc_client: create a moolib Rpc client that connects to a remote host at 127.0.0.1:1234
define_rpc_function: define a remote callable function on an Rpc endpoint using the define method
call_async_rpc: make an asynchronous RPC call to a remote host and retrieve the result via future.get
call_sync_rpc: make a synchronous RPC call to a remote host and print the returned result
